_comment: Nahuatl texts we lacked (#6559), found on IA with spelling variants after a holdings survey (37 Nahuatl-tagged books, 14 live, mostly codices). check-holdings: all new.

books.title: Huei tlamahuiçoltica omonexiti in ilhuicac tlatoca çihuapilli Santa María Totlaçonantzin Guadalupe
books.author: Luis Laso de la Vega
books.note: Mexico City 1649. Contains the Nican mopohua, the Nahuatl narrative of the Guadalupe apparitions.

books.title: Cantares en idioma mexicano (facsímile del manuscrito de la Biblioteca Nacional de México)
books.author: Anonymous Nahua singers (ed. Antonio Peñafiel)
books.note: Mexico 1904 photographic facsimile of the 16th-c. Cantares mexicanos MS: the largest corpus of Aztec song. Public-domain substitute for the in-copyright 1965 edition we hold hidden.

books.title: Dictionnaire de la langue nahuatl ou mexicaine
books.author: Rémi Siméon
books.note: Paris 1885. Built on Molina 1571; the standard Nahuatl dictionary for a century.

books.title: Rig Veda americanus: sacred songs of the ancient Mexicans
books.author: Daniel G. Brinton
books.note: Philadelphia 1890. The twenty sacred hymns Sahagún recorded, Nahuatl text with English and glosses.

books.title: Histoire de la nation mexicaine depuis le départ d'Aztlan jusqu'à l'arrivée des conquérants espagnols (Codex Aubin 1576)
books.author: Anonymous Nahua annalist (ed. J. M. A. Aubin)
books.note: Paris 1893 facsimile of the Codex Aubin with transcription and French translation.

books.title: Códice Aubin 1576 (copia de Antonio de León y Gama)
books.author: Anonymous Nahua annalist
books.note: 18th-c. copy by Antonio de León y Gama of the 1576 annals, Aztlan to the 1600s. Personal upload; the date is the original's.

books.title: Historia de los mexicanos por sus pinturas
books.author: Anonymous (attrib. Andrés de Olmos; ed. Joaquín García Icazbalceta)
books.note: Mexico 1891, Nueva colección de documentos, tomo 3. The earliest account of the Mexica creation myths.

books.title: The Güegüence: a comedy ballet in the Nahuatl-Spanish dialect of Nicaragua
books.author: Daniel G. Brinton
